from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/apps/rfc5769/rfc5769check.c')
text=p.read_text()

new='''                res = stun_check_message_integrity_by_key_str(TURN_CREDENTIALS_LONG_TERM, buf, sizeof(reqltc) - 1, key.auth_key, upwd, shatype);
